hypothesis: Conditional on the same known target query and identical public action counts, the signed return from an actually chosen diagnostic intervention changes which next intervention is informative. A trained tokenless native policy using that factual sign should change its chosen next intervention and improve exact public posterior query correctness over feedback-blind, sign-swapped, fixed-action and fully trained conventional controls, on prospectively reserved causal mechanisms; reproducible on Linux/Windows. Synthetic targeted task only, not independent causal discovery or general intelligence.

source.synthetic_mechanism: Three-stage four-variable binary SCM from R115 structural operators: U=op1(A,B); V=op2(C,D); Y=op3(U,V). 216 possible compositions with 90 distinct 16-bit truth tables. Each do-treatment is followed by an actual deterministic signed physical simulator consequence; no hidden operator, mediator, unchosen action outcome or query truth provided.
source.fit_rule: Select all 216 possible stage-triple descriptions except any whose full 16-bit truth function is one of 8 R116 heldout or 8 spent R115 reserved masks; then keep only compositions yielding observed calibration responses do(8)=+1 and do(9)=-1. This leaves exactly 24 FIT descriptions from 9 unique full functions with balanced 12/12 diagnostic sign; each FIT world is a fresh seeded index among those descriptions. Query=do(15) is public, target sign sealed.
source.novelty: Reserved 8 heldout masks are disjoint from FIT and R115 reserved. Four heldout mechanisms yield diagnostic do(7)=-1, four yield +1, each branch balances two query-sign +1 and two -1. Exact known-class information-gain reference chooses do(14) after negative and do(12) after positive for the fixed initial public observations. This is a deliberately structured identifiable intervention-dependency fixture; no broad extrapolation claimed.

training.training_target: Per FIT world, teacher computes exact public 216-composition 9:1 likelihood-based targeted 0-1 posterior error reduction of fourth do(12) vs do(14) given three already-observed actual factual signed calibration/diagnostic interventions; no private law or final query truth. Identical FIT observation histories and targets train each policy.
training.native: Q384 integer inference of 16-address signed feedback history, public query bits, next-offered action bits and probe-order/context bits, 45-to-48-to-24-to-1 native scorer. Exact ties choose first offered.
training.conventional: Fully trained public MLP and observation-sequence GRU from scratch; equal FIT histories, teacher targets and 512 updates; measured param/time different, not claimed matched FLOPs.
